append.detail: Follow-up from actual shared member-shell axe failures: the default skin wrapper rebound primary-strong to the fill accent, bypassing the existing daytime text step. The alias now keeps that same text step on default-skin Commons, preserving night and Stage. New focused regression tests cover the three reported backgrounds and unchanged dark/Stage states. Search, You and Vault controls use their visible shortcut/standing/counters in native accessible names; the You identity remains a description and the compact You name remains explicit. Existing contrast probes, thresholds and pins are unchanged. Focused source/rendered checks pass; full exact-head CI, rendered axe and production verification remain required.
